modality_or_condition: Required for high-risk system under relevant duties
authority: Provider must design system and provide instructions; no general authority over deployer's organization
discretion: Provider specifies system intended purpose and instructions; deployer retains Article 26(3) resource organization
accountability: Instruction/information supports oversight but not itself full accountability
direct_evidence: Article 13 requires instructions for use; Article 26(1) requires deployer use in accordance with instructions.
notes: Typed as a legally structured provider-to-deployer information/use relation; does not infer operational compliance.

modality_or_condition: Only where Article 43 procedure involves notified body
authority: Notified body verifies conformity within notified scope
discretion: Provider selects or follows route subject to Article 43 conditions
accountability: Body reports relevant documentation to notifying authority under Article 34(3); broader accountability varies
coding_status: Article 34(1) requires notified bodies to verify conformity according to Article 43 procedures; Article 43 sets conditional routes.
column14: No universal mandatory third-party assessment claim.

object_or_function: Eligibility and continued status as conformity-assessment body
accountability: Notification to Commission and Member States; body subject to monitoring
direct_evidence: Article 28(1) assigns procedures and monitoring; Articles 29–30 govern applications and notifications.
notes: Where accreditation body performs assessment/monitoring, Article 28(2) permits that arrangement.

authority: Authority may request information and logs
discretion: Request must be reasoned; provider's duty bounded to necessary information
accountability: Information enables official assessment; not by itself complete answerability
direct_evidence: On reasoned request providers shall provide information/documentation and applicable logs.
notes: Confidentiality applies under Article 21(3) and Article 78.

authority: Authority receives report and may take surveillance action
evidence_anchor: Feeds monitoring and evaluation; consequences lie in subsequent procedures
coding_status: Providers shall report serious incidents to authorities of the Member State where the incident occurred.
column14: No inference that a report necessarily establishes breach.

object_or_function: AI system presenting risk or non-compliance
modality_or_condition: Statutory tests and procedures under Articles 79–84
authority: Authority may require corrective action and specified restrictions/prohibitions
notes: Article 79 requires evaluation where sufficient reason exists and provides for appropriate measures following the procedure.
column15: Authority-object relation follows explicit statutory powers.

object_or_function: National measure addressing AI system risk
modality_or_condition: Article 79 notification and Article 81 objection/Commission concern conditions
authority: Commission evaluates and decides on justification in the specified safeguard procedure
discretion: Commission's review triggered and time-bounded by Article 81
accountability: National measure may be assessed against Union law
coding_status: Article 81 requires Commission consultation/evaluation when objections are raised or it considers a measure contrary to Union law.
column14: A bounded Union safeguard link, not routine command over every national decision.

modality_or_condition: When access is necessary for mandate within jurisdiction
authority: Fundamental-rights body accesses documentation; surveillance authority is informed
discretion: Access is bounded by mandate and necessity
accountability: No general reporting/accountability chain specified here
direct_evidence: Relevant public authority/body shall inform the market-surveillance authority of any documentation request.
notes: Preserves separate mandates and avoids a forced hierarchy.

object_or_function: Chapter V obligations and systemic risk
modality_or_condition: Within Chapter V conditions and procedural guarantees
authority: Commission has exclusive Chapter V supervision/enforcement authority; AI Office implements
discretion: Commission may choose measures under statutory tests and may dialogue first
accountability: Articles 91–94 and procedural rights; Article 101 includes hearing/review for fines
notes: Article 88(1) gives Commission exclusive Chapter V powers and entrusts task implementation to AI Office; Articles 91–93 supply powers.
column15: Distinct from general market surveillance; the AI Office is a Commission function under Article 3(47).

authority: Panel may alert; Commission may then exercise Chapter V powers
discretion: Panel alert is qualified and reasoned; no final decision authority assigned by Article 90
accountability: Commission informs Board of measures; provider procedural protections remain
direct_evidence: Scientific panel may provide a qualified alert; Commission through AI Office may act after informing Board.

modality_or_condition: Article 92 consultation and Article 90/93 information provisions
authority: Advisory/coordination connection as specified; no general veto evidenced
discretion: No discretion claim beyond specified consultation
accountability: Information links are not coded as full accountability
notes: Article 92 says AI Office may evaluate after consulting the Board; Article 90 requires informing the Board of measures.
